verdict.rationale: Segment's docs describe a documented tracking spec (track, identify, page) applied consistently across libraries and APIs, with code examples (analytics.track) and confirmation that the ingest API is live and the official SDK installs and works. This directly matches the story of collecting events via official SDKs implementing a documented spec. Missing for 10: explicit mobile/server SDK-specific documentation snippets and independent third-party corroboration beyond Segment's own docs/probes.
